# WinTrace

> Playwright-style traces for Windows desktop UI tests (.NET). Records each test step with before/after
> screenshots, timings, errors with stack traces, the UI Automation tree on failure and an optional screen
> recording, into trace.zip + a self-contained HTML viewer. Works with WinAppDriver and NovaWindowsDriver
> (Appium.WebDriver 4.x) and any test framework (MSTest, NUnit, xUnit). License Apache-2.0.

Facts an agent needs:

- Packages: `WinTrace.Appium` (adapter, brings `WinTrace.Core`), `WinTrace.Cli` (dotnet tool `wintrace`).
- Core API: `new TraceSession(testName, new AppiumTraceSource(() => driver))` in test setup;
  `session.Finish(testFailed, attachCallback)` in teardown; steps via `session.Recorder`
  (`Find`, `FindAll`, `Click`, `SendKeys`, `Clear`, `Step(name, target, () => ...)`, `Log`, `Group`).
- Only explicit steps are recorded. Wrap the project's central interaction helpers or page-object methods, or use the
  drop-in Appium extensions `ClickTraced`, `SendKeysTraced`, `FindElementTraced` (record on `TraceRecorder.Current`).
- Use `Step(name, target, Capture.None, ...)` for frequent probes/polls; pass the real test outcome to `Finish`.
- Traces are saved only for failed tests, to `TestResults/WinTrace/<test>_<time>_failed.zip` (+ `.html`).
- Keep `TraceOptions.Snapshots = SnapshotMode.OnError` (default): UI tree capture can take tens of seconds.
- Read a trace without a browser: `wintrace summary <zip> [--json]`,
  `wintrace inspect <zip> [--step N] [--tree] [--extract <dir> [--all]] [--json]` (shows the failure, stack trace,
  similar UI elements for a failed locator, and saves screenshots as PNG).

## Docs

- [Integration guide for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/ai-agents.md): step-by-step recipe to add WinTrace to a test project, and how to debug failures from traces.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/getting-started.md): MSTest, NUnit, xUnit setup and CI publishing.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/configuration.md): TraceOptions, TraceSession, video, performance, privacy.
- [API stability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/stability.md): what will not change before 1.0.
- [Trace format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/trace-format.md): contents of trace.zip.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TugaInVegas/WinTrace/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)
